scientific_scope_status: Input explicitly supplies rational mu, positive-definite S_0 and independent Gaussian Fourier blocks (A_j,B_j) with covariance [[S_j,T_j],[-T_j,S_j]], symmetric S_j and skew T_j, j=1,...,d. X(t)=mu+Z_0+sum_j(A_j cos jt+B_j sin jt) is stationary on [0,2pi). A rational open full-dimensional polyhedron K={a_i^T x>b_i} has m facets; LP feasibility/redundancy checks are charged and empty-interior/full-space cases handled. Dense d counts toward complete input length L. For p=Pr{X enters K}, the source proposes relative-eps estimation with confidence 1-delta in poly(L,eps^-1,log delta^-1) bit operations without a multiplicative 1/p. Log p or a mantissa plus binary exponent is the output. Conditional trajectory samples have a coupling controlling uniform waveform error zeta except probability eta, with expected cost polynomial also in eta^-1 and log zeta^-1 and an explicit cutoff failure. Rational finite outputs are not literally total-variation close to a continuous law.
